rating.source: Nominal half-flow jet-area scaling; actual added power depends on engine operating conditions.

source: Game half-flow wet kit: both jet areas halved while retaining fuel/nitrous balance and the original controller. 2026-10-19 E85 re-jet [D]: fuel jet area x (14.5/9.783568)*sqrt(747.5/787.025) = 1.4444 (AFR_gasoline/AFR_E85 times sqrt(rho_gasoline/rho_E85), the same rule as physics_sim 30310f5 for the full kit, 1.535 -> 1.845 mm), so half the full kit jet 1.845/sqrt(2) = 1.3046 mm (was 1.0854); the hyper burns E85. Nominal rating, not a measured dyno result.
